text: Emerald Queen Casino is owned and operated by the Puyallup Tribe of Indians, a sovereign tribal nation in Washington State.
short: The Puyallup Tribe of Indians owns and operates Emerald Queen Casino

source.name: Seattle Sounders FC: 'Sounders FC and the Puyallup Tribe of Indians' Emerald Queen Casino announce new naming rights deal, proudly introducing the Emerald Queen Casino Pitch at Lumen Field'
source.quote: Emerald Queen Casino is owned and operated by the Puyallup Tribe of Indians
